_doc: Point-in-time fact sheet for MAR retrospectives (retro/build_mar.py). Every value is tied to a source and becomes visible only on or after that source's 'published' date. A filing accepted after the 16:00 ET close is dated the next trading day. Generated from the transcribed raw figures; every growth rate, margin and rule-T value is computed from them, and the builder re-derives them. Per-share figures published before a split or stock dividend carry their own publication date ('eps_published', 'shares_published'); a split applies from its 'applies' date, the later of its ex-date and the first filing that states it.

rule_t._doc: Rule T values behind the engine's signal thresholds (retro/README.md, 'MAR'): the decade of the FY2006 10-K, the vintage public on 2008-01-04, is 1997-2006. Each year-on-year change comes from the latest filing published by then that reports both years; 'raw' keeps the figures, 'from' the filing of each change and 'sf_from' the filing of each year's synthetic fuel lines, and retro/build_mar.py re-derives every value. RevPAR and occupancy are those of comparable company-operated U.S. (from the FY2002 10-K North American) properties across the lodging brands, as each 10-K states them: no all-brand figure exists for 1997 (one brand), 2000 (the full-service brands only) or 2003 (segments only), and 2002's occupancy 'declined slightly' (words, no value); 1999's 'occupancy remained at 77.5 percent' is a change of 0. Fees are base management, franchise and incentive fees (no table before the FY2003 10-K gives them, so from 2000). Revenues and operating income exclude synthetic fuel (its revenue line, and its revenues less expenses, from each year's latest statement of income); 1997-1999 sales are each filing's own basis (before and after the 2002 discontinued operations); operating income is first tabled for 1999, so the margin from 2000.
